title: MissionChief Map Command Toolkit
description:
Bring your MissionChief UK tools together in one command interface.

Map Command Toolkit adds map controls, mission information, fleet and building tools, administration workflows, status panels and customisable settings to MissionChief UK. This is an independent community extension, not an official MissionChief product.

GET STARTED
Open MissionChief UK, click the extension icon, enable the toolkit, then apply and reload. Disable the Map Command Toolkit Tampermonkey userscript and any unpacked pilot copy first to avoid duplicate installations. A MissionChief UK account is required.

EARLY ACCESS
This first store release is still being tested. Background patient-transport sweep accuracy, Fast Map rendering and multi-tab behaviour are not fully verified. Start with one game tab and review scan results before confirming administration actions; those actions change the real game. Discord posting, private finance storage, credential storage and encrypted private imports are not available in this build.

YOUR SETTINGS
Ordinary userscript settings can be copied once; extension settings are then saved separately in this browser. Settings from an unpacked pilot do not transfer automatically to a store installation. Export safe settings before switching if needed.

DATA AND NETWORK
The toolkit reads MissionChief page and game data to provide its features. Public reference data, theme media, game graphics and optional map tiles load from their respective providers. No developer analytics or advertising is included. See the privacy policy for details.

Screenshots show a customised toolkit interface. Appearance and available features depend on settings and your game account.

Report reproducible issues through the support link. Store-installed updates are handled by your browser.
singlePurpose: Provide an integrated map and operations toolkit for MissionChief UK, helping players view mission information and manage their game vehicles, buildings and administration workflows within the game page.
storageJustification: Store the user's enable/disable choice, ordinary toolkit settings and supported game-data caches locally, separated by MissionChief origin. Settings are separate from the original userscript and are not synced across devices. Private credential, Discord and private finance persistence are blocked.
scriptingJustification: After the user enables the toolkit, inject packaged toolkit code into the top-level MissionChief UK page to integrate with the game's native map and UI objects. Also read the extension's page status for the popup and load the locally packaged MapLibre engine when Fast Map is selected. Injection refuses an existing toolkit runtime.
hostJustification: missionchief.co.uk and its HTTPS subdomains: run the toolkit and access the native game page, map and game endpoints. raw.githubusercontent.com: fetch allowlisted public toolkit reference rules and update metadata. tkb-gaming.scot: fetch public MissionChief guide JSON. leitstellenspiel.s3.amazonaws.com: read native game marker images. Cross-origin extension requests are restricted to approved read-only paths and omit credentials; external writes are rejected.
remoteCodeExplanation: All executable toolkit, adapter, service-worker and MapLibre JavaScript is included in the ZIP. The map worker imports only its packaged chrome-extension URL. Public JSON, map styles/tiles, images and audio are data/media; they are not remotely executed extension code.
dataCategoryExplanation: The toolkit handles game user/alliance identifiers and page content for its visible features. It uses native game form authenticity/CSRF tokens only for same-origin game actions and the existing signed-in session; it does not request passwords or export session tokens to developers. It responds to interactions for map controls and workflows without developer analytics. Asset/map providers receive ordinary IP/request metadata. Game locations and credits are not device GPS or real financial data.
reviewerInstructions: Requires a signed-in MissionChief UK account at https://www.missionchief.co.uk/. The extension is off by default. Disable any Map Command Toolkit userscript or unpacked copy. Open the extension popup, enable the toolkit, and apply/reload the game tab. Open the in-game toolkit button to inspect Map, Incidents, Fleet, Administration, Finance, Status and Settings. Basic UI and map controls do not require alliance admin privileges. Alliance administration and patient transport workflows require the appropriate game role and game missions/vehicles. Review scans before confirming actions: they affect the real game. Discord posting, private finance persistence and encrypted private imports are unavailable in this Early Access build. There is no extension-specific login, paywall or subscription. Automated Node/DOM contract and transport regression reports are included in the ZIP; they are simulated checks, not a claim of complete live-game verification. We do not provide the developer's personal game credentials.
